name: Messe Wien
notes: messecongress.at now redirects (301) to vieconcenter.at (rebrand: VIECON Messe Wien Congress Center). Scrapes /events plus /events/pN pagination (stops when a page repeats the previous one). Parses server-rendered <li class="h-full rounded-[16px]..."> event cards; each has a date span (3 possible formats: DD.MM.-DD.MM.YYYY / DD.-DD.MM.YYYY / DD.MM.YYYY), place, entrance, organiser and U-Bahn spans, plus an external event-site link used as url/source_id. Site publishes no category label, so category is always null. Venue is always Messe Wien / Congress Center, Trabrennstrasse 7, 1020 Wien, so district is hardcoded to 1020. price never shown on the listing, always null. Only ~10 events listed total, spanning to March 2027 (site publishes far beyond the 180d horizon since these are big trade fairs booked long ahead).
